answer: Make every newcomer need a sponsor who stakes part of their own vault on the invite. If the new account is later caught as a clone, the sponsor's bond is slashed, so vouching for fakes gets expensive fast. Each invite leaves a public thread back to whoever backed it, and a farm of puppets ends up hanging from one wallet, easy to spot like a lone road down a canyon. Honest recruiters risk little; sybil farmers bleed coins.
